history.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: one standalone realistic Yuan northern-China map sprite. Original game reconstruction, not exact monument. Photoreal hand-made grey tile, buff earthen plaster, brown timber, stone; same restrained realistic detail density as Song map kit, no toy look. CRITICAL orthographic2:1 dimetric camera yaw45 pitch30; ground axes slopes+0.5/-0.5 precisely, all parallel edges remain parallel, verticals vertical, no perspective. Thin FLAT rectangular ground apron, visible LEFT/FRONT/RIGHT ground corners; no thick slab. Transparent RGBA background, whole object with 10% transparent margin, upper-left light and very short lower-right contact shadow. No text, lettering, people, animals, signs, flags, UI, watermark, modern objects, sky, scenery, checkerboard, Qing architecture, elaborate gold dragons. Subject: ONE Yuan Dadu WHITE STUPA, Tibetan Buddhist inverted-bowl pagoda inspired by Yuan Miaoying White Pagoda TYPE but compressed original game adaptation. Do NOT copy reference multi-storey tower shape: reference ONLY gives realistic stone texture and sprite detail. White lime-plastered rounded inverted-bowl body, broad stepped square lower platform, short neck above bowl, narrowing ringed conical spire and small restrained bronze finial/parasol. No tiled roofs, no multi-storey balconies, no North Sea Qing bottle-stupa outline, no prayer flags, no figures or inscriptions. Entire tower uncut within tall portrait composition. The base footprint square8x8, VERY clear flat square apron in2:1 dimetric diamond with exactly equal-length visible edges and +/-0.5 slopes. Soft warm left-top lighting, right lower short contact shadow. Background absolutely alpha0, not a painted glow.

notes: 用元大都覆钵白塔取代宋多层楼阁塔功能位；仅类型意象，尺度8×8为游戏占地，塔身塔刹栏杆非妙应寺复原；避免把明改寺名作为元代原名。
